output.summary: A deciduous small tree or large shrub native to Europe and northern and northeastern Asia, bird cherry bears drooping clusters of flowers and black, strongly astringent fruit. In Russia, dried berries are milled into flour for cakes, while fresh fruit may be minced and cooked as jam; some parts, including the fruit, contain potentially poisonous glycosides.
